checks.detail: Runtime/build: fresh embedded-assets build from candidate 543cf61f, all blocking checks pass, product_ui_separation=pass. Auth: live shell renders (screenshot-0-0) with inline invalid-email validation (screenshot-0-1). Golden path: host-triggered product drive concluded pass 16/16 in both receipts (4.58s/5.09s time series), authority honestly labeled self-report; durable results visible on every signed-in surface in two independent runs (project 'Focus demo', completed task due 2026/09/18, calendar chip Sep 18, focus history, reminder SENT in Settings). Interface: all six section-8 primary surfaces captured live with correct headings and nav. Persistence: 20/20 rust units cover restart persistence, reminder idempotency/retry-once, token single-use/expiry/recovery, rate limiting; visible cross-surface data corroborates the durable store; the live restart leg stays tracked. Security: private ops reject without session, generic wrong-password errors, minimal capability manifest. Visual: section-9 properties hold (neutral canvas, restrained accent, thin rules, icon+text nav, truncating titles, no prohibited patterns), matching the 9.1 board intent. Dispositions: find.golden-path-surfaces-missing=pass; find.signedin-views-no-live-capture=pass; fnd.replay-collector-cannot-conclude-golden-path=pass; find.first-run-gui-drive-missing=insufficient_evidence; find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered=insufficient_evidence; find.isolated-store-probe-path-mismatch=insufficient_evidence; find.advisory-whitebox-stale-layout=insufficient_evidence;

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.

developer_outcome.summary: Built and drove the release embedded-assets build live via the provisioned WebDriver. The live webview exposed a divergence units miss: sign_out switched the App root element type and remounted GoldenPathProbe, erasing terminal state at 12/16; fixed in src/App.tsx. Re-driven live: one trigger click, terminal pass 16/16, anonymous smoke delta preserved.

risk_note.summary: The live webview can expose divergences the in-process units never see — IPC timing, probe gating in the shipped build, or slow mail-sink steps — and surface fixes could regress the frozen contract.
risk_note.validation: Most likely to end insufficient_evidence if only the dev build or rust units are checked; mitigation is requiring the embedded-assets live drive with the terminal probe state recorded in the developer report.
risk_note.why_now: The host lands the collector trigger-and-poll extension this loop, so the first extended receipt on the new hash is the only chance to convert eight loops of stalled evidence.
